title: How do you verify AI stock research?
author: Alarmed-Patience-100
selftext: The problem with using AI for stock is that the answers can sound convincing when something is off. For example, Ive asked for the latest news on a stock but gotten articles that were months old, and answers might look similar but refer to different metrics or reporting periods. The figures totally fool me. Now i break stock research down into a table of individual claims, metric definitions, reporting periods, source URLs, publication dates, and supporting passages with anvitamate. For news and figures, Id filter out articles older than a set cutoff when searching for the latest updates and check primary sources first, such as SEC filings and company IR pages. I still have to verify every number myself. Where is my convenience??? How do you guys handle this? Do you have a better way to verify if it's true?
